messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands with their back to the camera, facing the water, and shifts their weight and turns slightly while remaining in place.","camera":"The camera is positioned behind the subject at a medium distance, framing them from the waist up against the horizon, and stays largely steady with minor handheld movement.","clothing":"The person wears a dark green, high-waisted, backless garment with a glossy, leather-like finish.","hair_color":"The hair is a vivid, saturated blue.","hairstyle":"The hair is styled into two small low buns at the back of the head.","identity":"A person with a slim build and tanned skin is shown from behind, with their face turned away and not visible.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone terrace or platform beside a calm body of water under a bright, hazy sky."},"uncertain":["The exact type of garment (e.g., dress, bodysuit, or top) is unclear because only the back and waist are visible.","The person's face and front appearance are not visible, so facial features and front clothing details are unknown."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The houndstooth dress was removed and replaced by a dark green, glossy, high-waisted backless garment visible from the waist down. The upper body appears bare in the visible frames, and the reference top and footwear are not visible.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's current outfit entirely with the complete reference outfit: patterned sleeveless top, dark green high-waisted leather-like pants, and matching footwear, while preserving everything else.
uncertain: Whether the dark green garment is the reference pants or a different backless garment is unclear because the lower legs and feet are not visible.
Whether the reference top was applied on the front side of the body is unclear because the person remains facing away.
unexpected_changes: The person's upper back and shoulders are now bare, whereas the reference outfit includes a sleeveless top.
